final_answer: Proteins most strongly associated with body-composition changes after feminizing GAHT were LEP (higher percent fat; q=0.000545696) and PRL (higher breast volume; q=0.000279). Several proteins were associated with both outcomes at FDR ≤ 0.05, including MUC1, CST6, CA6, PLB1, CCL24, DPEP1, CYTL1, PSG1, ENDOU, PGLYRP3, IVL, PI3, DEFB4A, MMP3, LEP, and others. In total, 38 proteins were significant for percent fat and 249 for breast volume, with 28 overlapping proteins. Most shared associations were negative, meaning higher protein levels tracked with lower fat percentage and/or smaller breast volume.
